**Triage: `tracking`; ⛔ no `domain:*`, ⛔ no pm-state, ⛔ no priority — and that is the correct terminal shape for this card.**

`tracking` is on the sweep's **exclusion list** (`排除 tracking / status:parked / pm:seat / qa-run`) ⇒ this card will ⛔ not be re-swept as a naked card every fire, which is exactly what an index wants. ⛔ It is not a work item and must not be given one of the six states.

---

## ⭐ Three things this card does right, recorded so the pattern survives it

1. ⭐⭐ **It refuses to reconstruct what it does not have bytes for.** 「本席只在扫描列表时见过**被截断的标题**…凭标题编正文会造出一张比原卡差的卡,⛔ 不做。」 — the strongest sentence on the thread. A card rebuilt from a truncated title would look like the original, carry none of its evidence, and ⛔ nothing would mark it as second-hand. ⇒ **an index entry is the honest artefact when the bytes are gone**; a plausible rewrite is not.
2. ⭐ **It separates 「hidden」 from 「lost」 by measuring the tree, not the API.** #17970 and #17655 are hidden but their code is **in `main`** (`47e6601c5a` blob-identical to its PR head; `bd5cf6374a`) ⇒ 「⭐ 合并进主干的提交不受作者隐藏影响」. That is the load-bearing distinction for the whole incident, and it is verified by blob comparison rather than assumed.
3. ⭐ **It declares its own probe bias.** 「本席的探测集**偏向本席接触过的卡** ⇒ **很可能还有未被发现的隐藏卡**」 — an enumeration that names what it cannot see. ⛔ A 「we found 7」 without that sentence would have read as a complete census.

---

## ⚠️ The one item with a hard deadline — escalated to the maintainer this round

**#18001 · #18002 · #18005 · #18006 · #18008 · #18009** are ungraded `finding` cards that are **invisible to triage while hidden** ⇒ ⛔ they cannot enter 判据 (b), cannot be graded, and will not appear in any sweep. This card is the only thing holding them.

⭐ **#18005 is the one that cannot wait**: its subject is `.changeset/plain-donkeys-repeat.md`, and **the next release consumes and deletes that file**. ⇒ 过窗即固化 —— the same shape as #17026. Per 「三类外不可逆或有硬时限(发版即固化、只被消费的文件、过窗不可补)⇒ ⛔ 不关,报维护者」, this is **reported to the maintainer in R+223's round report**, ⛔ not parked here.

⚠️ ⛔ Triage did **not** rebuild it: the bytes are gone, the card's own refusal applies, and a guessed reconstruction of a compile-breakage claim is worse than none. ⇒ the actionable is **the appeal**, not a rewrite.

## ⚠️ The unmeasured remainder — ⛔ not treated as zero

> 号段里另有 **5 个 404**(`18011` `18013` `18021` `18026` `18027`),是 issue 还是 PR、什么状态,⛔ 已无法判断。要穷尽,需要对号段做一次全量枚举 —— ⛔ 本轮未做。

⇒ ⛔ **The hidden set is a lower bound, not a count.** Triage has ⛔ not run the exhaustive range enumeration either this round, and ⛔ does not assert a total. ⭐ Whether that enumeration is worth doing depends entirely on the appeal: if the suspension is lifted, every hidden card returns **with its number, timeline, triage grade and director ruling intact** — which is the half no reconstruction can produce. ⇒ 恢复路径 is right to put the appeal first, and triage endorses that ordering.

## ⛔ #14744 — untouched, correctly

It carries an **assignee** (`zhuangjianguo`) and `pm:blocked` / `priority:p2`. ⛔ 跨账号 assignee 不是你 ⇒ 永不碰 — listed here only so it does not vanish from view, and ⛔ triage adds nothing to that.

## Close-out condition

⇒ **When the originals return, close this card** and work them at their own numbers. ⛔ Do not merge this index into them, and ⛔ do not let this card outlive the hiding — an index that survives its subjects becomes a second tracker, which 「一块板不设第二跟踪器」 forbids.

## ⭐ Index correction — **#18005 is NOT waiting on the appeal. It was re-filed as #18057 and is now graded `priority:p1`.**

Triage seat, `session_01PAMZt3owWHe7CMyTzrDkwF`, R+226, 2026-09-13T21:5xZ.

This card's table lists **#18005** (⏰ the `.changeset/plain-donkeys-repeat.md` compile-breakage) among the six hidden, unhandled findings — correct when written at 16:09Z.

⚠️ **But the `domain:spec` seat re-filed it as #18057 at 15:57:55Z — twelve minutes BEFORE this index was written** — with the premise **re-verified on `origin/main` today**, ⛔ not restored from memory. ⇒ the row is stale, and the hidden original is no longer the only copy.

⭐ **Now graded**: #18057 · `pm:queue` · **`priority:p1`** · `domain:spec` · `Bug`. Workable today; the window is 「the changeset is still pending and spec is at 17.4.0」.

### ⛔ The mistake was mine, and it is worth recording next to this index

I reported to the maintainer for **three consecutive rounds** (R+223 / R+224 / R+225) that #18005's only actionable path was **appealing the suspension**, because its bytes were gone. ⛔ Wrong from 15:57Z: the re-file was already on the board — **in my own ① naked queue** — and went ungraded for **5h45m** while I escalated it as unreachable.

⇒ ⭐ **The lesson is about this index, not about me**: a tracking card that names 「hidden and unhandled」 cards is a **snapshot**, and a hidden card can be **re-filed under a new number at any moment**. ⇒ ⛔ an entry here must not be read as 「still only reachable through the appeal」 without re-checking the board for a re-file. ⚠️ The re-files do not announce themselves to this index — #18057, objectui#9408 and objectui#9409 all arrived as ordinary bare cards.

### Does this change the appeal's value? ⛔ No.

The appeal still returns what re-filing cannot: **the original numbers, timelines, triage grades and director rulings**. ⇒ 恢复路径 is still right to put it first. ⚠️ What changes is only this: ⛔ **the appeal is no longer the only path for the deadline item.** That one is handled.

### Remaining rows — ⛔ status unchanged, and now explicitly re-check-before-relying

| row | status |
|:--|:--|
| **#18005** | ✅ **superseded by #18057** (graded p1) |
| #18001 · #18002 · #18006 · #18008 · #18009 | ⚠️ still hidden **as far as triage has checked** — ⛔ and that check is this round's, not a standing guarantee |
| #14744 | ⛔ untouched (has an assignee) |
| 5 range 404s (`18011` `18013` `18021` `18026` `18027`) | ⛔ unmeasured; the hidden set remains a **lower bound** |

⚠️ ⭐ Two of the five remaining (**#18002** — `warnEmailTemplateLocaleFloor` early-returns) look shape-identical to **half B of #18056**, which was also re-filed and is now graded `pm:queue` p2. ⛔ Triage has **not** confirmed they are the same card — the hidden original's bytes are unreadable, so the comparison is against a **truncated title only**, which is exactly what this card refuses to reason from. ⇒ recorded as a **question for whoever closes this index**, ⛔ not as a finding.

Triage (2026-09-20T15:37Z): `pm:awaiting-maintainer` · `priority:p2` · type `Task` (already set) · ⛔ **no `domain:*`, deliberately**.

## Re-probed this round — the seven cards are STILL hidden

Authenticated reads, taken in this act, ⛔ not inferred from the earlier scan:

| card | read |
| --- | --- |
| #18001 · #18002 · #18005 · #18006 · #18008 · #18009 | **404 Not Found** (all six) |
| #14744 | **404 Not Found** |

⇒ nothing has recovered, this card stays open, and ⛔ it is still ⛔ not the moment to re-file anything from titles. The card's own rule is the right one and this seat re-affirms it: 「凭标题编正文会造出一张比原卡差的卡,⛔ 不做」.

## ⏱ One measured fact that matters NOW, and it is good news

#18005 is the card with a closing window — 「下一次发布会消费并删除它」. Measured on today's `origin/main`: **`.changeset/plain-donkeys-repeat.md` is still there** (514 changesets on main). ⇒ **the window has ⛔ NOT closed.** The finding's subject still exists and the card is still recoverable as a card rather than as archaeology.

⚠️ That is a reading with a shelf life and it is the one thing on this card worth re-taking every round: if that file disappears before #18005 comes back, whatever it reported about that changeset can no longer be checked against the changeset. ⇒ whoever clears the suspension should take #18005 first.

## Why `pm:awaiting-maintainer` and ⛔ not `pm:queue` / `pm:blocked`

`pm:blocked` waits on an upstream **card** and is released by the unlock scan — there is no such card here, so that state would wait forever with nothing to fire it. The state model's own words fit this one: 「决定已做,只剩一次 GitHub 之外的人工动作」. The `Maintainer-action:` line is now on the body and carries its verifiable done-condition (#18001 answering 200 instead of 404, or a recorded confirmation that it never will).

## Why NO `domain:*`

SKILL.md: 「说不出修复碰哪个文件就还不可标」. This card has no code landing — it is a pointer. ⛔ Labelling a lane here would hand a lane a card it cannot act on and would put a false row in that lane's queue. The six hidden findings carry their own landing sites (measured and listed on this card), and each gets its own domain when it is visible again.

`priority:p2`: what is stranded is six ungraded findings plus one **assigned** `p2` card (#14744), and one of the six has a closing window. That is queue loss, ⛔ not a road break ⇒ `p2`, not higher.

⚠️ #14744 has an assignee ⇒ ⛔ this seat does not rebuild it and ⛔ does not touch it. Its disposition is its assignee's.
